mapper.select: SELECT sub.id id, sub.agreement_id agreementId, sub.sale_contract_id saleContractId, sub.month month FROM frame_agreement_sub sub LEFT JOIN sales_contract con ON con.id = sub.sale_contract_id where con.sales_contract_id = #{ncSalesContractId} and sub.relate=1 and sub.deleted=0 and con.deleted=0 limit 1
